servinfo.title: Exhaust System Description
servinfo.ptxt: The exhaust system consists of an exhaust manifold incorporated in the cylinder head, a three-way catalytic converter (TWC), exhaust pipes, a muffler and seals, gasket, and so on.

The three-way catalytic converter is emission control device added to the exhaust system to lower the levels of Hydrocarbon (HC), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Oxides of Nitrogen (NOx) pollutants in exhaust gases.
